scope: School Chemistry mock: AQA 7405 taught 3.1.9 Rate equations, Required Practical 7 theoretical data interpretation, and 3.1.10 homogeneous Kp. No buffers or later untaught material.
decision: Existing early/late mock practice includes kinetics temperature effects, Arrhenius graph and Kp mole fractions; this release adds a distinct RP7 initial/continuous-monitoring data comparison and cross-topic quantitative diagnostic. It is reinforcement, not a proven previously missing official syllabus bullet.

newOriginalExamQuestions.target: Independent rate orders, k, units, new initial rate from controlled data
RP7 reactant concentration tangent and average gradient with signed and positive rates
Zero-order straight-line trend, first-order half-life and k units
Arrhenius gradient, intercept, Ea and rate constant at a new temperature
N2O4/NO2 equilibrium mole fractions, partial pressure, Kp and pressure comparison

numerics.v210_01: Orders 2,1; k=0.100 dm^6 mol^-2 s^-1; new initial rate 9.00e-4 mol dm^-3 s^-1
numerics.v210_02: Signed tangent slope -9.00e-4; positive instantaneous rate 9.00e-4; mean 9.50e-4 mol dm^-3 s^-1
numerics.v210_03: X zero order k=1.00e-3 mol dm^-3 s^-1; Y first order t1/2=20 s and k=0.0347 s^-1
numerics.v210_05: N2O4=0.600 mol, NO2=0.800 mol; partial 60.0/80.0 kPa; Kp=107 kPa; Kp fixed at constant temperature

qa.marking: chemistry-rates-marking-v210.js isolates independent marks and rejects wrong numerical orders/signs. Conservative suggestions can miss unfamiliar correct workings; manual review is supported.
qa.hardSafety: The original questions analyse supplied readings and conceptual chemical models only; no hands-on protocol is required.

preservation: Existing card and question IDs unchanged
Existing first Maths mock remains Year 1 Pure only
No changes to XP, progress/profile/settings data or cloud-sync implementation
World galleries, assets, images and photo progress unchanged
limitations: No complete AQA specification requirement-level crosswalk is certified by this update.
No claim of student mastery, examiner-equivalent auto-grading, or full 2015–2026 original-paper archive.
Flashcards reinforce data interpretations; the presence of other similar legacy cards has not been exhaustively ruled out.
Five new questions are original authored practice, not official AQA past-paper copies.
